name: Shenzhou 11 Guidao Cang
about: Shenzhou 11 Guidao Cang (2016-061G), a crewed vehicle (Shenzhou OM), launched 2016 Oct 16. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (R).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2016 Nov 18), held fixed
